topic: 高可用容量与运行治理
title: 真实Prometheus基数削减：源端聚合66条为4条，保留总量和分方法规则，拒绝直接删标签碰撞
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 找出增长的标签和值域，关联消费者后在源端规范化或丢弃无用指标，避免删除区分标签制造冲突。
对照样本速率、Head序列、内存和规则输出，记录减少量及保留能力。

conversion.original_title: 制定一次高基数指标削减的验收流程。

body:
## 操作任务
实现normalize(rows)，输入是同一采样时刻不同原始(method,route)计数器系列，每项method/route/value；业务已审批只保留GET/POST及/health、/items/{id}两类路由，不需要逐对象ID查询。仅将/items/十进制数字ID规范成/items/{id}，/health原样保留，其他route、非GET/POST、负数/非有限数/布尔value均ValueError。按(method,规范route)先累加全部counter再按键排序，每项输出method/route/value，不改原输入，不能覆盖丢数或合并GET/POST。本题静态可重放快照，生产动态counter还需独立设计重置、生命周期和滚动兼容，不能直接按此例保证任意动态流单调性。真实66系列采集与参考4系列采集使用独立冷启动Prometheus，核对up、样本数、Head系列、进程RSS及两个method记录规则输出；另验证只删route标签造成真实重复样本拒绝。不得承诺旧Head历史立刻消失或RSS必然同比下降，消费者已批准失去对象ID维度。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
官方Prometheus3.2.1 Windows原生进程、真实采集/TSDB/PromQL和记录规则，Python受控静态counter端点，独立raw/错误删标签/fixed临时数据库。观察Head、每秒采样量和进程RSS，不把瞬时RSS大小当性能收益证明。仅验证这组静态快照和已批准聚合维度，不代表线上长时容量、动态counter重置、远端存储或原故障编号验收完成；未调整宿主网络/身份、未部署或构建镜像。
版本边界：本题Prometheus3.2.1在直接删标签的负例中up仍可为1，但冲突样本被丢弃，prometheus_target_scrapes_sample_duplicate_timestamp_total增加且总量错误；不能以up=1证明样本完整，也不把负例伪写成整个目标必然down。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import contextlib,copy,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile,threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
import task
from cardinality_fixture import native,wait_for,query,value,request,observed
binary=shutil.which("prometheus") or shutil.which("prometheus.exe")
assert binary and "3.2.1" in subprocess.check_output([binary,"--version"],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5)
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
rows=[dict(method=method,route="/items/"+str(i),value=100+i) for method in ["GET","POST"] for i in range(1,33)]+[dict(method=m,route="/health",value=500) for m in ["GET","POST"]]
unchanged=copy.deepcopy(rows);calls={"/raw":0,"/fixed":0,"/drop-label":0}
class Metrics(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def do_GET(self):
  calls[self.path]+=1
  data=task.normalize(copy.deepcopy(rows)) if self.path=="/fixed" else copy.deepcopy(rows)
  if self.path=="/drop-label":
   for row in data:row["route"]="removed"
  text="# TYPE training_requests_total counter\n"+"".join('training_requests_total{method='+json.dumps(r["method"])+',route='+json.dumps(r["route"])+"} "+str(r["value"])+"\n" for r in data)
  body=text.encode();self.send_response(200);self.send_header("Content-Type","text/plain; version=0.0.4");self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
server=ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),Metrics);thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
try:
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-prom-cardinality-") as temp,contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
  root=pathlib.Path(temp);target="127.0.0.1:"+str(server.server_port)
  raw,rp=stack.enter_context(native(root/"raw",target,"/raw"))
  bad,bp=stack.enter_context(native(root/"drop-label",target,"/drop-label"))
  wait_for(lambda:value(raw,"count(training_requests_total)")==66)
  wait_for(lambda:value(bad,'up{job="private-cardinality"}')==1)
  def duplicate_drops():
   return any(x.startswith("prometheus_target_scrapes_sample_duplicate_timestamp_total ") and float(x.split()[-1])>0 for x in request(bad,"/metrics").splitlines())
  wait_for(duplicate_drops)
  assert value(bad,"sum(training_requests_total)")!=8456
  print("NATIVE_PROMETHEUS_66_RAW_SERIES_NAIVE_LABEL_REMOVAL_UP_ONE_BUT_DUPLICATE_SAMPLES_DROPPED_TOTAL_WRONG",flush=True)
  print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: source-side bounded aggregation consumed by actual Prometheus",flush=True)
  fixed,fp=stack.enter_context(native(root/"fixed",target,"/fixed"))
  wait_for(lambda:value(fixed,"count(training_requests_total)") is not None)
  expected=8456
  assert value(fixed,"count(training_requests_total)")==4
  assert value(fixed,"sum(training_requests_total)")==value(raw,"sum(training_requests_total)")==expected
  wait_for(lambda:len(query(raw,"training:requests:by_method"))==len(query(fixed,"training:requests:by_method"))==2)
  def results(base):return {r["metric"]["method"]:float(r["value"][1]) for r in query(base,"training:requests:by_method")}
  assert results(raw)==results(fixed)=={"GET":4228,"POST":4228}
  before,after=observed(raw,rp),observed(fixed,fp)
  assert before["head_series"]>after["head_series"] and before["rss_bytes"]>0 and after["rss_bytes"]>0
  assert before["scraped_samples"]==66 and after["scraped_samples"]==4 and after["target_up"]==1
  assert rows==unchanged and all(v>0 for v in calls.values())
  print("NATIVE_PROMETHEUS_CARDINALITY_OBSERVATIONS "+json.dumps({"before":before,"after":after,"rss_reduction_not_assumed":True},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
  print("NATIVE_PROMETHEUS_SOURCE_AGGREGATION_66_TO_4_SUM_AND_BOTH_METHOD_RECORDING_RULES_PRESERVED_HEAD_SAMPLES_RSS_OBSERVED",flush=True)
  try:task.normalize([dict(method="GET",route="/unapproved",value=1)])
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError("unbounded route taxonomy accepted")
finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
